name: uberasm-automatic-alternating-jumps-v1
title: Automatic Alternating Jumps V1.1
description:
This makes the player alternate continuously between a normal jump and a spinjump.

yoshifanatic's update
- Made the sound effects configurable. Especially the jump sound, so it's easy to account for AddmusicK.
- Optimized the code a bit by utilizing tables.
- Added checks so the jump doesn't happen while in a lakitu cloud, P-Balloon, climbing, stunned, doing the victory pose, or while the game is paused.
- Made it so Mario displays the jump pose when doing the regular jump.
- Made it so the auto jump is more of an auto swim while underwater.
